The catch-up-on-reopen build that shipped Wednesday is what turned a repeat of the outage into a normal morning.

⚠️ TWO PARTIALS THIS MORNING, BOTH WITH NAMED CAUSES AND ONE ALREADY SOLVED BY A SIBLING ROUTINE. The marketing engine's Brivity crawl hit a NEW Chrome failure — "multiple browsers connected, none selected," which a non-interactive run cannot answer — and ninety minutes later the folder-sync run found the one-call fix and banked it, no action needed from you. The second is a deliberate throttle, not a fault: the database lane cut its reconnect batch from 15 to 5 and parked the other 9, because that lane and the ISA past-client lane turned out to be the same lane. That one is waiting on YOUR ruling, not on a repair.

🔴 AND THE FLEET FOUND SOMETHING REAL THIS MORNING RATHER THAN JUST REPORTING ITSELF HEALTHY: Money Pulse broke a books-versus-bank disagreement on operating cash at 5:59 and named the authority correctly. It is the first time that alert has fired with a specific, sourced cause behind it instead of a standing pattern. Details are on the money tile — deliberately without figures, because this page is public.
